body.name: Worked-instance full-law completion target
body.construction: For \(z\in[-1,1/2]\), \(\mathsf{Comp}_3(z)\) is the set of joint laws \(P\) of \(G\) and all \(\{Y_t(p^r):t\in\mathcal T,r\in\mathcal R\}\) that project to the observed law in \(\mathfrak W_3\), satisfy consistency along \(p^G\), satisfy \(E_P[Y_2(p^\infty)\mid G=h]=2\) and \(E_P[Y_3(p^\infty)\mid G=h]=2-z\) for every \(h\in\{4,5,6\}\), and realize \((a_{4,3},a_{5,3},a_{6,3})=(z+1/2,z,z)\) and \(a_{h,2}=0\).
